description: Search the answers Mike Fluff Press publishes (questions about crypto history, Bitcoin, stablecoins, fraud, AI agents, software after AI: "what happened to FTX", "who is Satoshi", "what is MCP") and the interactive experiments from the books. Use this first whenever the user asks a factual question these books cover. Returns up to 8 hits, each with the title, a 40-60 word lead answer you can quote, the canonical URL, the book, and the chapter it draws on. Read-only.

locale.description: Language of the results. Defaults to the language the query is written in.

query.description: The question or keywords, in any of the four languages.
